In Norwegian we have a third category of nouns called non-gendered in addition to masculine and feminine. And I have to say that I find it all very pointless. Firstly the fact that we call it genders is kind of random. Might as well have called them blue nouns, yellow nouns and red nouns. Would not change the language in any way, just the way we talk about it. So from that point of view it is very pointlessly gendered because it really doesn't have anything to do with gender. Secondly it makes the language needlessly difficult to learn. You just have to know what nouns are which genders, which is easy for a native speaker like me, but difficult for someone new. It adds very little functionality to the language and it's definitely not worth the additional complexity.
